newsitem.title: CHINA: China executes eight for bombings, robberies.
newsitem.headline: China executes eight for bombings, robberies.

text.p: Chinese authorities on Thursday executed eight people in the restive northwestern Moslem region of Xinjiang for staging a series of bombings, murders and robberies that left 18 people dead, the Xinhua news agency said.
Mahmut Abdurahman, Jilil Bilali and six others were put to death after the Xinjiang Higher People's Court upheld death sentences handed down by a lower court, Xinhua said.
The group committed violent terrorist crimes "by extremely cruel and criminal means", Xinhua quoted the court verdict as saying.

The court found them guilty of planting home-made bombs on public buses in the regional capital of Xinjiang on February 25 coinciding with funeral rites in Beijing for paramount leader Deng Xiaoping. The bombs killed nine people and injured 58 others.
The group also robbed and murdered nine taxi drivers, shop owners and pedestrians between December 18, 1996 and February 20, 1997, the news agency said.
